title: Sr. Manager - IT Web
age_limit: Not more than 45 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.
summary: Advanced Weapons & Equipment India Limited (AWEIL) is inviting applications from Indian nationals for the post of Sr. Manager - IT Web on a full-time contract basis. The initial tenure is 2 years, extendable up to 4 years. Interested candidates must submit their application in hard copy along with necessary documents to the designated address by the deadline.
eligibility_bullets: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science/Information technology or MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information technology or NIELIT 'B' level from a recognized university/institution.
5 years post qualification experience in website maintenance and development.
Upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the prescribed application format from the AWEIL official website www.aweil.in or ddpdoo.gov.in.
Fill out the required details and attach self-attested copies of birth certificate, educational qualifications, and experience certificates.
Affix one passport-size photograph on the application and attach a second passport-size photograph.

Send the complete hard copy of the application via speed post or courier to the Director (HR), Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited, Ordnance Factory Kanpur premises, Kapli Road, Kanpur UP - 208009.
Clearly superscribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST 'Sr. Manager-IT Web'".
